name: Hyper-coupling Cascade Risk
trigger: Tight temporal dependency between two critical systems without a circuit breaker.
indicator: Direct API call with no timeout and implicit trust of response speed.
mitigation: Introduce asymmetric timeouts or an asynchronous queue (strategic slack).

name: Positive Feedback loop / Reconciliation Oscillation
trigger: Automatic recovery system that conflicts with manual override or experiences significant latency.
indicator: Rapid sequence of state changes (flip-flopping) in logs during incident resolution.
mitigation: Implement exponential backoff for reconciliation and explicit 'Pause' flags.

name: Invisible Dependency Chain
trigger: Component A depends on Component B which relies on C via a shared resource not explicitly modeled.
indicator: Unexpected failure of A when C is degraded, while B reports healthy.
mitigation: Explicit service mapping including L7 dependencies.
